from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, os, tempfile, textwrap

def uudecode(path):
    data=Path(path).read_text(errors='ignore').splitlines()
    out=bytearray(); started=False
    for line in data:
        if line.startswith('begin '): started=True; continue
        if line.startswith('end'): break
        if not started or not line: continue
        n=(ord(line[0])-32)&63
        chunk=line[1:]
        i=0
        while i < len(chunk):
            c1=(ord(chunk[i])-32)&63; i+=1
            c2=(ord(chunk[i])-32)&63 if i<len(chunk) else 0; i+=1
            c3=(ord(chunk[i])-32)&63 if i<len(chunk) else 0; i+=1
            c4=(ord(chunk[i])-32)&63 if i<len(chunk) else 0; i+=1
            out.extend(bytes([(c1<<2)|(c2>>4), ((c2&15)<<4)|(c3>>2), ((c3&3)<<6)|c4]))
    return bytes(out)
for uu in ['libarchive/test/test_read_format_rar5_compressed.rar.uu','libarchive/test/test_read_format_rar5_stored.rar.uu']:
